title: Sharing patterns
subtitle: Multi-instance via nested providers
description: How to share or isolate forms across components.
content: `useField` is context-only. Nest `FormProvider` for independent instances (e.g. two editors side by side).

sections.title: One form tree
sections.content: Shell owns `useForm`; children call `useField` under a single `FormProvider`.

sections.title: Nested providers
sections.content: Each instance gets its own `useForm` + `FormProvider`. Inner context wins for descendants.

sections.title: useQueryForm Provider
sections.content: `useQueryForm` returns a bound `Provider` component — same idea, less boilerplate.
